title: Law to install package lockers in every council district
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to install at least 10 parcel lockers in each council district within 5 years, at a rate of at least 2 per district per year. DOT would set site-selection criteria and locker standards, maintain an online map and list of locations, and report to the mayor and Council on the program's performance, with reports due by January 1, 2027 and August 1, 2029.
